API ReferenceZIdentity APIGroupsGroups Ops Get Group Members
Groups Ops Get Group Members
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/groups/:id/users

Retrieves the list of users details for a specific group using the group ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier for the group (used in endpoints where group ID is required).

QUERY PARAMETERS
offset
int32

Possible values: >= 0

The starting point for pagination, with the number of records that can be skipped before fetching results.

limit
int32

Possible values: >= 0 and <= 1000

The maximum number of records to return per request. Minimum: 0, Maximum: 1000

loginname
string[]

Filters results by one or multiple login names.

loginname[like]
string

Filter results by login name using a case-insensitive partial match.

displayname[like]
string

Filters results by display name using a case-insensitive partial match.

primaryemail[like]
string

Filter results by primary email using a case-insensitive partial match.

domainname
string[]

Filters results by a domain name or by multiple domain.

idpname
string[]

Filters results by one or more identity provider names.

Responses
​
200
401

The request was successful, and a paginated list of users details are returned.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
results_total
int64
REQUIRED

The total number of user details available.

pageOffset
int64
REQUIRED

The starting point of the current page in pagination. Helps determine which set of records is being displayed.

pageSize
int64
REQUIRED

The number of records included in a single response page.

next_link
string
REQUIRED

URL link to the next page of user detail records, if available. Helps to navigate through paginated results.

prev_link
string
REQUIRED

URL link to the previous page of user detail records, if available.

records
object[]
REQUIRED
]
